summary: Client.listActiveMarketplaceMessages now sets marketplaceMessages (None at call start and on failure, [] on an empty success, the message list otherwise) without changing its request or logging. Added sdk/economy with MarketListing, parse_listing (whitelisted @Message, @ActivityArgument currency:price, optional @SaleId/@MessageId/@ItemDesignId/@Quantity; unparseable values None; secret-shaped values refused), listings_from_messages and observed_listings (None when unread). 10 tests in tests/test_marketplace_listings.py with mocked responses; inventory entry cites them; documented in docs/baseline/economy-market.md.

contract_status_changes.before: Marketplace messages were only logged; nothing could read listings programmatically
contract_status_changes.after: Listings are typed, whitelisted records with explicit not-observed vs empty states

residual_risks: @SaleId, @MessageId, @ItemDesignId and @Quantity are unverified attribute names from prior capture analysis; only @Message and @ActivityArgument appear in fixtures.
